title: CommunicationEditRequest
description: Validation rules for editing a communication event. F0021-S0006. At least one field must be provided (enforced by FluentValidation; error code: no_changes). Author within 24h or Admin only; enforced server-side.

body.description: Updated body content. If provided, must be 1–4000 characters.

subject.description: Updated subject. If provided, must be 1–200 characters.

outcome.description: Updated outcome. If provided, must be 1–1000 characters.

occurredAt.description: Corrected timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Must not be in the future.
